segments.ja523:1.1: “Atha bravi brahā indo, vatrabhū jayataṃ pitā;
segments.ja523:2.3: Isippalobhane [isipalobhike (sī. syā.), isiṃ palobhike (pī.)] gaccha, isisiṅgaṃ alambuse.
segments.ja523:3.1: “Purāyaṃ amhe acceti [nācceti (syā. ka.)], vattavā [vatavā (sī. syā. pī.)] brahmacariyavā;
segments.ja523:3.3: Nibbānābhirato vuddho [vaddho (pī.), buddho (syā. ka.)], tassa maggāni āvara”.
segments.ja523:4.3: Isippalobhane [isipalobhike (sī. syā.), isiṃ palobhike (pī.)] gaccha, santi aññāpi accharā.
segments.ja523:5.3: Tāsampi hotu pariyāyo, tāpi yantu palobhanā”[palobhikā (syā. pī.)].
segments.ja523:6.1: “Addhā hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, santi aññāpi accharā;
segments.ja523:6.3: Tādisiyo pavarā ceva, asoke nandane vane.
segments.ja523:7.1: “Na tā evaṃ pajānanti, pāricariyaṃ pumaṃ gatā;
segments.ja523:8.3: Taveva vaṇṇarūpena, savasamānayissasi”[vasamānāpayissasi (syā.), vasamānāmayissasi (pī.), taṃ vasamānayissasi (ka.)].
segments.ja523:9.3: Vibhemi cetaṃ āsāduṃ, uggatejo hi brāhmaṇo.
segments.ja523:11.3: Missā missitu [missetu (sī. syā. pī.)] micchantī, isisiṅgaṃ alambusā.
segments.ja523:16.1: “Vilaggā [vilākā (sī. syā. pī.)] mudukā suddhā, pādā te suppatiṭṭhitā;
segments.ja523:16.3: Gamanā kāmanīyā [kamanā kamanīyā (sī. pī.)] te, harantiyeva me mano.
segments.ja523:17.3: Vimaṭṭhā tuyhaṃ sussoṇī, akkhassa phalakaṃ yathā.
segments.ja523:19.3: Payodharā apatitā [appatītā (sī. syā. pī.)], aḍḍhalābusamā thanā.
segments.ja523:22.3: Āyatā ca visālā ca, nettā tava sudassanā.
segments.ja523:25.1: “Na te samasamaṃ passe, asmiṃ pathavi [puthuvi (pī.)] maṇḍale;
segments.ja523:25.3: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ”.
segments.ja523:26.5: Ehi taṃ upagūhissaṃ [upaguyhissaṃ (syā.)], ratīnaṃ kusalo bhava”.
segments.ja523:29.3: Cavitamhi [cavi tamhā (syā. ka.)] brahmacariyā, yathā taṃ atha tositā.
segments.ja523:35.1: “Na juhe na jape [jappe (ka.)] mante, aggihuttaṃ pahāpitaṃ;
segments.ja523:35.3: Ko nu me pāricariyāya, pubbe cittaṃ palobhayi.
segments.ja523:36.1: “Araññe me viharato, yo me tejā ha sambhutaṃ [sambhataṃ (pī.)];
segments.ja523:37.3: Avadhiṃ [avadhī (syā. pī. ka.)] cittaṃ cittena, pamādo [pamādā (syā. pī.)] tvaṃ na bujjhasi”.
segments.ja523:39.3: Iccānusāsi maṃ tāto, yathā maṃ anukampako.
segments.ja523:40.3: Araññe nimmanussamhi, svajja jhāyāmi [svājjajjhāyāmi (sī. pī.)] ekako.
segments.ja523:41.3: Puna vā tādiso hessaṃ, maraṇaṃ me bhavissati”.
segments.ja523:42.1: “Tassa tejaṃ [tejañca (sī. pī.)] vīriyañca, dhitiṃ [dhitiñca (pī.)] ñatvā avaṭṭhitaṃ [suvaḍḍhitaṃ (sī.)];
segments.ja523:43.1: “Mā me kujjha [kujjhi (pī.)] mahāvīra, mā me kujjha [kujjhi (pī.)] mahāise;
segments.ja523:43.3: Mahā attho mayā ciṇṇo, tidasānaṃ yasassinaṃ;
segments.ja523:43.5: Tayā saṃkampitaṃ āsi, sabbaṃ devapuraṃ tadā”.
segments.ja523:44.3: Tvañca bhadde sukhī hohi, gaccha kaññe yathāsukhaṃ”.
segments.ja523:45.1: “Tassa pāde gahetvāna, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ;
segments.ja523:47.3: Patīto sumano vitto, devindo adadā varaṃ”.
segments.ja523:48.3: Nisippalobhikā [na isipalobhikā (syā.), na isipalobhiyaṃ (pī.)] gacche, etaṃ sakka varaṃ vare”ti.
